decision_basis: Each requested main-city anchor has official policy or market evidence, but none of the three multi-city corridors has a single fully current, fully scope-matched, reproducibly downloaded end-use electricity-price chain for every city in its geography. This is a source/data gate only, not permission to optimize.

tou_price_snapshot.customer_scope: State Grid proxy-purchase commercial-industrial, two-part, 1-10 kV

diesel.unit: CNY/t, NDRC 0# vehicle-diesel standard-product maximum retail ceiling
diesel.not_authorized: CNY/L conversion without a same-date official Beijing local notice

jjj_beijing.carbon_price: PASS_SHADOW_ONLY: CEA close 75.02 CNY/tCO2e on 2025-06-30 is a national dated observation and may be a common internal shadow price, not a Beijing-local or road-logistics statutory cost.
jjj_beijing.tvci: PASS_DIRECT: exact Beijing column exists in trusted S1-2025 48-slot table.
blocking_gaps: The numeric electricity snapshot is July 2024, not a current permanent tariff.
The regional geography includes Tianjin and Hebei, but this gate only authorizes a clearly labelled Beijing-anchor surrogate after an explicit later approval.

tou_price_snapshot.customer_scope: Guangzhou/Foshan 1-10 kV general-commercial price table, but TOU eligibility is limited to former ordinary-industrial special-transformer users; value excludes funds and surcharges
tou_price_snapshot.sharp_peak: 1.3759375 derived as official peak 1.10075 x 1.25; only in sharp-peak trigger periods
tou_price_snapshot.times: peak 10:00-12:00 and 14:00-19:00; valley 00:00-08:00; otherwise flat; sharp peak 11:00-12:00 and 15:00-17:00 during Jul-Sep and qualifying >=35C days

prd_guangdong.shenzhen_exception: Guangdong provincial policy expressly excludes Shenzhen. Shenzhen has a separate official TOU policy, but the original page could not be downloaded by the available local TLS client; it must not be replaced with Guangzhou/Foshan numbers.

diesel.unit: CNY/t, NDRC 0# vehicle-diesel standard-product maximum retail ceiling
diesel.not_authorized: CNY/L conversion without a same-date official Guangdong or Shenzhen local notice

prd_guangdong.carbon_price: PASS_SHADOW_ONLY: same national CEA observation only; do not substitute a Guangdong or Shenzhen local market price for CEA without a separate decision.
prd_guangdong.tvci: PASS_DIRECT: exact Guangdong column exists in trusted S1-2025 48-slot table.
blocking_gaps: PRD includes Shenzhen, whose price policy and applicable user scope are separate from Guangdong province.
The preserved Guangzhou/Foshan numeric tariff is an October-2021 historical table and not a general commercial/depot tariff by default.

tou_price_snapshot.customer_scope: State Grid proxy-purchase commercial-industrial, two-part, 1-10 kV; policy TOU scope is narrower for industrial categories

diesel.chongqing: 6.90 CNY/L and 8110 CNY/t official maximum retail for 0# vehicle diesel VI
diesel.chengdu: 8135 CNY/t shown in the same NDRC table; no same-date official CNY/L conversion preserved

cy_chongqing_sichuan.carbon_price: PASS_SHADOW_ONLY: same national CEA observation only; it is not a Chongqing or Sichuan local statutory road-logistics cost.
cy_chongqing_sichuan.tvci: PASS_DIRECT: exact Chongqing column exists in trusted S1-2025 48-slot table; the preregistration explicitly chooses it as the cross-province main-city curve approximation.
blocking_gaps: The corridor includes Chengdu/Sichuan. No Sichuan end-use TOU chain is in this gate, so Chongqing electricity price cannot be applied corridor-wide.
The numeric electricity snapshot is July 2024 and user-scope alignment for a logistics depot needs a later contract.

authorizes: use the three named S1-2025 TVCI province columns without copying Shanghai values
cite the saved official sources and their dates/hashes
use CEA 75.02 CNY/tCO2e dated 2025-06-30 only as an internal shadow-price observation
does_not_authorize: using Shanghai electricity or diesel values for Beijing, Guangdong, Shenzhen, Chongqing, or Sichuan
treating any historical monthly proxy-purchase price as a current permanent tariff
treating CEA as a local market price, road-logistics tax, or present legal allowance cost
converting tonne-denominated diesel ceilings to litres without a same-date official local conversion
any C31 optimization or solver configuration
next_gate_required: freeze a same-period electricity snapshot and exact depot user/electrical-voltage category for each city used in C31
obtain a reproducible Shenzhen original-page download or an official locally downloadable equivalent
choose and document a Sichuan electricity-price chain or explicitly restrict the price anchor to Chongqing-only
obtain same-date local CNY/L diesel notices where the model requires litres
